desc:
A game inspired by the movie Final Destination: Bloodlines

SkyView, a large tower similar to the one in Natural Disaster Survival. This game is inspired by the SkyView version by Stickmasterluke 🗼

If you’re looking for the game "FD6 SkyView: Natural Disaster Survival", this is not that game.

To push, equip the "Push" tool, approach someone, and touch their character 🙎

If the "Anti-Push" option is enabled, you cannot be pushed. You can be pushed if someone has the "Strong Push" gamepass.

🗺️ All map credits go to Stickmasterluke
